briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 intensify AGI race amid record Q3 funding

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple high-capability models this month while compute buildouts accelerate. Prompt injection and multi-agent security remain top risks. Global AI investment hit $11.8B in Q3.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with advanced reasoning; Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek R2 matched GPT-4o performance at lower cost. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B variant.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA shipped 1.2M Blackwell GPUs; Microsoft and Google announced new 100k H100-equivalent clusters in Texas and Nevada. TSMC 2nm AI chip yields reached 65%.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will any lab achieve reliable 1000x human speed reasoning before 2028?
